title: Policy Update: Enhanced Lug Structure for Actionability & Verifiability
description: This policy establishes an enhanced, structured format for feature and task lugs to ensure they are actionable, testable, and verifiable by any AI agent. This new structure includes explicit `implementation_steps`, `success_criteria`, `code_references`, `example_interactions`, and `test_cases`, moving beyond detailed text descriptions to provide concrete guidance for development, testing, and verification.
resolution_reason: Policy reviewed and incorporated into agent operational guidelines for lug creation and interpretation.
